Quote
Status
1. Client & reference

Phone and email are kept with the saved quote for your records. They are not printed on the quote.

2. Your price boxes
Number of boxes

Pick which range goes in each box. Type in Override to set a box price by hand. The ★ box is highlighted on the quote (in “Different products” you can highlight one per product): green for uPVC, pink for aluminium, blue for hardwood, navy for anything else.

3. Windows

Add a second group when part of the house is a different product, e.g. uPVC to the front and aluminium to the rear.

Total window area0.00 m²
4. Extra items in the price

Doors and other items added to every price box, such as an aluminium slider. Each is listed under scope of works.

5. Replacements (fixed price)

Adds a "Replacement of …" line to the scope of works and adds the price to every price box.

6. Optional upgrades
7. CT Tax

Added to every price box. It isn't mentioned anywhere on the quote.

8. Your details
9. Price list (€ per m²)

Prices load from SharePoint when you sign in.
